rfis.question: Wall heights: no deck / B.O. elevations printed; conflicting section readings
rfis.loaded: Closed by plans plus rule. S121/S122 (read visually) print no B.O. deck or T.O. steel elevations (S001 abbreviation B.O.D. only). Heights are DERIVED by vector at the printed scale of the sections, each with datums cited in the canon. Where two printed geometries differ and the break is not drawn, the HIGHER value is loaded (U-146): Riser 160 10.38 (4/A312) over 9.68 (A301 F-F); new service addition 19.17 (F-F flat) over 18.51-18.96 (A-A); A-Z1-01/02 24.77 (type A full height) over 11.0 (D-D graphic); BDC 135 8.67 over 8.17. Where the section draws a joist bottom chord or an existing floor over the wall, that is the underside of structure (brief rule 3): C1-Z2-03 / A1-Z2-06 11.51; existing area 8.17; 2F to the wood truss bottom chord 8.77. The partial B/B1 in the existing area stops at the joist (8.17), under ceiling + 6".
